page.notes: The right edge is cut away; the partly visible column of the next page at the right is not transcribed. Some letters in the first lines are faint, notably "īnnumera" (possibly "innumera" with a macron) and "quò" (read as "quò"). Words such as "sed", "non" and "Principem" are read as printed; the printed "summe" is rendered "summé". Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off and only fragments are visible (e.g. "8.", "me", "fpi", "tri"); they are not transcribed. The first word of the first line is partly cut off at the top. The line "medum" is as printed and may be a misprint for "modum"; uncertain.
